mapper.update: UPDATE background_job SET status = #{toStatus}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, now()), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND (status = #{fromStatus} OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until <= now()))
